canonical_definition: Counting refers to determining the number of objects, typically in visual data (e.g., images), with some definitions extending to objects/events in broader contexts or requiring reasoning over long sequences. Some operationalizations emphasize accurate enumeration (e.g., aligning with BBH object_counting benchmarks), while others focus on estimation or aggregative reasoning tasks, such as assessing quantities in remote sensing data or natural adversarial samples. The construct consistently centers on quantification but varies in scope regarding input modalities, contextual complexity, and precision requirements.
